llm.guidance: This skill appears internally consistent for a market-data integration: it only needs curl and an optional MKTS_API_KEY. Before installing, confirm the mkts.io service and publisher (no homepage or provenance is provided here). Be aware the agent will make network requests to mkts.io and, if you use the programmatic registration flow, will send an email/name to that service — avoid sending private emails or secrets. If you plan to use it regularly, consider registering a separate throwaway email and obtaining an API key for rate limits, and test in a limited, monitored environment first.
